title: Data Reporting and Analyst
text: Data Reporting and Analyst at Interpro - VIC (Melbourne, CBD & Inner Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). Dynamic and varied role Australia’s fastest growing energy retailer Career Develop and Opportunities About the company National online energy retailer seek an experienced Data and Reporting Analyst to join their Melbourne team. The company is rapidly becoming one of the fastest growing gas and electricity retailers with a very agile, versatile and inclusive culture that focuses on maximizing opportunities in an ambiguous and dynamic industry. About the role You will be responsible for end to end maintenance and delivery of Business Intelligence reports and processes. You will have a strong ability to work autonomously and multitask competing priorities. It will be essential that you are able to consult with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to ensure to effective delivery of the most sustainable solutions. The successful candidate will consistently execute their attention to detail, be agile in a faced paced environment, utilize their strong time management skills and interpersonal skills. Duties & responsibilities Design, develop and implement Business Intelligence solutions (Reporting, Analytics, ETL) and Data Model Design Engaging with and consulting with Technical and non-technical stakeholders Identifying, communicating and implementing continuous improvement opportunities across the business (including day-to day support and improvement of accurate/timely integration of data dashboards, KPI’s and visuals) Troubleshooting maintenance of all BI artifacts (ETL, Data marts, .NET and BAU reports) Daily, weekly and monthly distribution and generation of performance and regulatory reports Maintain various data driven operational processes (commissions and sales reconciliations) Skills & Experience Microsoft excel expert Minimum 4 years Business Analyst, Data Analytics, stakeholder management, user testing, cost/benefit analyst and proven experience deploying ASP.net solutions Intermediate-advanced in MS Transact SQL and visualizing data with Tableau and solve/translate raw data Exceptional and well developed interpersonal skills to consult and communicate verbally/written information to internal technical and non-technical professionals Culture You will be reporting directly to the Data and Reporting Manager whilst working within a small yet supportive and inclusive team. Your team will provide you with the resources and facilitate your personal and career growth to ensure success of those who are also self-motivated, driven and ready for a challenge. How to Apply Click APPLY to submit your application.
